name: Short Cut Beef Ramen with Spinach, Bamboo Shoots & Basil

ingredients.name: instant ramen noodle soup, beef flavor

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat. Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beef, salt, and pepper; stir-fry until just cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove to a plate and set aside. (Reserve pot for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp neutral vegetable oil
227 g beef strips for stir-fry
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add hot water (from the tap) to the pot and bring to a boil over high heat. Meanwhile, drain bamboo shoots. Once the water is boiling, add bamboo shoots and noodles (reserving flavor packets). Stir to combine the soup and cook, stirring occasionally, until noodles are soft, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (227 g) can bamboo shoots
2 (85 g) pkg instant ramen noodle soup, beef flavor

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons. Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ small pkg fresh basil
½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Remove soup from heat, add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add flavor packets, and stir until combined.
To serve, divide soup between bowls, then top with cooked beef and basil. Enjoy!
